NONE: A1 used, usually as the object of a verb or preposition, to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has just been mentioned or is just about to be mentioned
他（指男性）；它（指雄性動物）

› used after a verb or preposition to refer to a person or animal that has just been mentioned, or is just about to be mentioned, and whose sex is not known or not considered to be important. Many people consider this use to be offensive and prefer to use him or her or them instead, or it for an animal.
他（尤用於正式場合，指代剛提過或就要提到的人或動物，其性別不詳或並不重要）

example: If you see Kevin give him my love.
如果你見到凱文，替我向他問好。
What's Terry up to - I haven't seen him for ages.
泰瑞在搗甚麼鬼？我好久沒見到他了。
Why don't you give him his present?
你為甚麼不把他的禮物給他呢？
We've just got a new cat, but we haven't named him yet.
我們有隻剛生下來的小公貓，但還沒有給牠取名字。
A human being's ability to talk makes him unlike any other animal.
人可以說話，這使其不同於任何其他動物。
If anyone comes to see me, ask him to wait.
如果有人來找我，就讓他等一下。

NONE: A2 used to refer to a male object of a verb that is the same person or animal as the subject of the verb
B2 used to emphasize a particular man, boy, or male animal
（用於強調或指稱）他自己，他本人，它自己
A2 If a man or boy does something by himself, he does it alone or without help from anyone else.
› not to be, seem, or feel as happy or as healthy as usual
不太高興；健康狀況不佳
› UK informal used when describing or asking about a man's state of mind when he is physically ill
（用於描述或詢問某人生病後的精神狀態）
› used to refer to an object of a verb that is the same person or animal as the subject of the verb, when referring to a person or animal whose sex is not known or not considered to be important
他（用作動詞受詞，與主詞所指一致，所指的人或動物性別不明，或不重要）

example: He'd cut himself shaving.
他刮鬍子時刮傷了自己。
Most nights he would cry himself to sleep.
大多數晚上他都是哭著入睡的。
Did you want to talk to the chairman himself, or could his personal assistant help you?
你想和主席本人談談，還是讓他的私人助理幫助你？
Tom was going to buy a bookcase, but in the end he made one himself.
湯姆本來打算買一個書櫥，可是最後他還是自己做了一個。
Little Timmy made that snowman all by himself.
小提米獨力堆成了那個雪人。
Why did you leave your little brother by himself?
你為什麼把你的弟弟丟下不管？
Johnny's got the apartment to himself next week.
強尼下周將一個人獨享那棟公寓。
Is Tom all right? He doesn't seem quite himself this morning.
湯姆沒事吧？他今早看起來不太對勁。
He's well enough in himself - he just can't shake this cold off.
他精神很好——只不過感冒還沒痊癒。
Any fool can teach himself to type.
連傻子都能自己學會打字。
